SELECT s.format, s.region, count(*) versions, count(DISTINCT s.store_id) stores, min(s.store_id), max(s.store_id), (SELECT min(calendar_date)||' '||max(calendar_date) FROM dim_date WHERE fiscal_year='FY2025/26' AND fiscal_period=2) p2
FROM dim_store s GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2

WITH sl AS (
  SELECT f.* FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=f.sale_date
  WHERE d.fiscal_year='FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period=2),
fmt AS (SELECT store_id, count(DISTINCT format) nf FROM dim_store GROUP BY 1 HAVING count(DISTINCT format)>1)
SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM sl) lines,
 (SELECT count(DISTINCT sales_line_id) FROM sl) distinct_ids,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT receipt_id,line_no FROM sl GROUP BY 1,2 HAVING count(*)>1)) dup_receipt_line,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM fmt) stores_multi_format,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM fact_return_line) ret_rows,
 (SELECT count(DISTINCT return_line_id) FROM fact_return_line) ret_distinct,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM fact_return_line r WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM fact_sales_line f WHERE f.sales_line_id=r.sales_line_id)) orphan_returns,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM sl WHERE net_amount<=0 OR quantity<=0) nonpos,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM sl JOIN dim_store s USING(store_key) WHERE s.store_id=999) s999,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM sl JOIN dim_product p USING(product_key) WHERE p.category='ZZ Test') zz,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM sl JOIN dim_store s USING(store_key) WHERE s.store_id=900) web_lines,
 (SELECT max(sale_date) FROM fact_sales_line) maxdate

WITH sold AS (
  SELECT f.sales_line_id, s.format, f.net_amount, f.sale_date, w.status,
         COALESCE((SELECT SUM(r.refund_net) FROM fact_return_line r WHERE r.sales_line_id=f.sales_line_id),0) refund
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
  JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=f.sale_date
  LEFT JOIN fact_web_order w ON w.web_order_id=f.receipt_id AND s.store_id=900
  WHERE s.store_id<>999 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test'
    AND d.fiscal_year='FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period=2)
SELECT format, status, count(*) n, sum(net_amount) sold_net, sum(refund) ret_net, round(100*sum(refund)/sum(net_amount),2) rate, max(sale_date) mx
FROM sold GROUP BY ROLLUP(format, status) ORDER BY 1,2

WITH x AS (
  SELECT f.sales_line_id, f.quantity, f.net_amount, f.sale_date,
         sum(r.refund_net) refund, sum(r.quantity_returned) qret, min(r.return_date) first_ret, max(r.return_date) last_ret, count(*) nret
  FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=f.sale_date
  JOIN fact_return_line r ON r.sales_line_id=f.sales_line_id
  WHERE d.fiscal_year='FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period=2 GROUP BY ALL)
SELECT count(*) lines_returned, sum(CASE WHEN qret>quantity THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) over_qty,
 sum(CASE WHEN refund>net_amount+0.01 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) over_net,
 sum(CASE WHEN first_ret<sale_date THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) before_sale,
 max(last_ret-sale_date) max_lag, sum(CASE WHEN nret>1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) multi
FROM x

WITH sold_lines AS (
  SELECT f.sales_line_id, s.format, f.net_amount
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
  JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date
  WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period = 2
),
refunds AS (
  SELECT sales_line_id, SUM(refund_net) AS refund_net FROM fact_return_line GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT 'FY2025/26' AS fiscal_year, 2 AS fiscal_period, l.format AS store_format,
       ROUND(100.0 * COALESCE(SUM(r.refund_net), 0) / SUM(l.net_amount), 2) AS return_rate_pct
FROM sold_lines l
LEFT JOIN refunds r USING (sales_line_id)
GROUP BY l.format
ORDER BY l.format
